signal: ServiceTrade launched Smart Insights, AI-powered business intelligence for commercial contractors

email.body1:
Brad, saw ServiceTrade just launched Smart Insights, bringing AI business intelligence to commercial contractors.

A new product motion like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp on the story, and that is where good pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ServiceTrade off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brad, quick follow-up for ServiceTrade.

Launching Smart Insights raises the bar on pipeline faster than headcount usually keeps up. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ServiceTrade needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brad, last bit of proof for ServiceTrade.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ServiceTrade's reply rate likely compares to peer B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brad, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while Smart Insights ramps, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a fresh product launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to ServiceTrade either way.
